title: Three Evenings and One Short Scroll
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：legend　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 legend 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the storyteller ① told the legend that no listener in the town would have recorded, and he said the telling was the whole of the evening. The ② legend, meaning the tale itself and not the scroll, ran three evenings and stayed unrecorded in the book; a legend, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ legend in that town had the same short scroll beside it, and the ④ legend at the far bridge, meaning the name they kept for the children to remember and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A legend, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the storyteller said the recording is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the legend was the whole of the matter, meaning the truth and not the tale. The ⑥ legend, meaning the truth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; legend, he said, is either something you tell or the only word that means both a tale and a truth. He said the truth is the part they remember.

By 1957 the ⑦ legend had become a line in an anthology, and the anthology had become an argument about the short scroll. The ⑧ legend of the whole thing, the storyteller wrote in August, was one town and three evenings of recording; legend, he said, is either the name at the far bridge or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ legend I remember is the tale recorded in the anthology, which closed in 1959 and is still recorded as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ legend, my mother said in 1961, is the only tale that improves by being recorded; every legend, she said, is a truth that has agreed to look like a tale. She said the truth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 传说；传奇（指镇子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 传说；传奇（指那个传说本身，与卷轴相对）
C. 固定搭配：tell the legend 讲述这个传说
D. n. 传说；传奇（指留给孩子们记住的那个名字那一个）
E. n. 传闻之事（抽象总称，指一处镇子的传说之事）
F. n. 传说；传奇（指故事集里写到、被记载的的那一个）
G. n. 真相、信实（指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 信实（抽象总称，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: told the legend that no listener in the town would have recorded
The legend, meaning the tale itself and not the scroll
the legend at the far bridge
the legend was the whole of the matter
the legend had become a line in an anthology
The legend of the whole thing
A legend, my mother said in 1961

answers.why: tell the legend 意为“讲述这个传说”，1952 年那位说书人把镇子里没有一位听客肯记载的一个传说做了一遍。
legend 意为“传说；传奇”，指那个传说本身而不是卷轴，它经过了三个傍晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
legend 意为“传说；传奇”，指镇子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一卷薄薄的卷轴。
legend 意为“传说；传奇”，指最远那座桥头留给孩子们记住的那个名字那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
legend 意为“真相、信实”，指一件事里人人都听却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个真相就是那件事的全部。
legend 意为“信实”，指人人都听却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个传说，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
legend 意为“传说；传奇”，指故事集里写到、被记载的的那一个，到 1957 年这一个成了故事集里的一行。
legend 意为“传闻之事”，说书人八月写道，整件事的传说之事是一处镇子和三个傍晚的记载。
legend 意为“传说；传奇”，我记得的是故事集里记载过的那一个，1959 年讲完了，至今仍被说成镇子里最安静的一个。
legend 为抽象总称，母亲 1961 年说，传说是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的传说。
